title: 除了……以外 in Chinese: "Except" and "Besides" (HSK 3 Grammar)
description: How to use 除了……以外 (chúle... yǐwài) in Chinese: "except" with 都, "besides" with 还 and 也, word order, common mistakes and HSK 3 examples.
h1: How to Say "Except" and "Besides" with 除了……以外
lede: 除了……以外 (chúle... yǐwài) sets one thing apart from the rest. Whether it means "except" or "besides" depends on the word that comes next: 都 for "except", 还 or 也 for "besides" or "as well as".

paras: 除了 + A + 以外，(subject) + 都 + verb.
When the second part has 都 (all), A is the one exception: everyone or everything else is included, but not A. 以外 is optional, so 除了这个字 and 除了这个字以外 mean the same.

examples.zh: 除了哥哥以外，我们都去了。
examples.py: Chúle gēge yǐwài, wǒmen dōu qù le.
examples.en: All of us went except my older brother.

examples.zh: 除了星期天以外，他每天都工作。
examples.py: Chúle xīngqītiān yǐwài, tā měi tiān dōu gōngzuò.
examples.en: He works every day except Sunday.

examples.zh: 除了这个字，别的我都认识。
examples.py: Chúle zhège zì, biéde wǒ dōu rènshi.
examples.en: I know all the others apart from this character.

sections.h2: With 还 or 也: "besides" and "as well as"
paras: 除了 + A + 以外，(subject) + 还 / 也 + verb.
When the second part has 还 or 也, A is included and something is added to it. 还 usually adds something else that the same person does. 也 is common when a different person does the same thing.

examples.zh: 除了游泳以外，我还喜欢跑步。
examples.py: Chúle yóuyǒng yǐwài, wǒ hái xǐhuan pǎobù.
examples.en: Besides swimming, I also like running.

examples.zh: 我们除了吃饭以外，还去看了电影。
examples.py: Wǒmen chúle chī fàn yǐwài, hái qù kàn le diànyǐng.
examples.en: As well as having dinner, we went to see a film.

examples.zh: 除了我，妹妹也去过中国。
examples.py: Chúle wǒ, mèimei yě qù guo Zhōngguó.
examples.en: Besides me, my little sister has been to China too.

sections.h2: Word order and the most common mistake
paras: The subject can come before 除了 or after the 除了 part: 我除了游泳以外 and 除了游泳以外，我 are both fine. 都, 还 and 也 always go after the subject and before the verb, so 除了他，都我们去了 is wrong.
The most common mistake is to leave out 都 or 还, or to use the wrong one. They change the meaning completely: 除了他，我们都去了 means he didn't go, while 除了他，我们也去了 means he went and so did we.

examples.zh: 除了这个以外，别的都可以。
examples.py: Chúle zhège yǐwài, biéde dōu kěyǐ.
examples.en: Anything but this one is fine.

paras: With 都不 or 都没有, the sentence means "nobody but" or "nothing but". To ask "what else?" or "who else?", use 还 with a question word.

examples.zh: 除了他，大家都不知道这件事。
examples.py: Chúle tā, dàjiā dōu bù zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
examples.en: Nobody knows about this except him.

examples.zh: 除了面条以外，你还想吃什么？
examples.py: Chúle miàntiáo yǐwài, nǐ hái xiǎng chī shénme?
examples.en: What else would you like to eat besides noodles?

worksheet.title: 除了……以外 Worksheet: HSK 3 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 除了……以外 worksheet for HSK 3: 17 exercises (都 or 还, word order, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write 都 or 还 in each gap. Does the English mean "except" or "besides"?

items.zh: 除了爸爸，我们＿＿去过中国。
items.en: All of us except Dad have been to China.

items.zh: 除了苹果以外，我＿＿买了香蕉。
items.en: As well as apples, I bought bananas.

items.zh: 除了星期六，我每天＿＿要上班。
items.en: I have to go to work every day except Saturday.
Besides singing, she also likes dancing.

items.zh: 除了这件衣服，别的我＿＿不喜欢。
items.en: Apart from this top, I don't like any of them.

items.zh: 除了打扫房间以外，我＿＿洗了衣服。
items.en: Besides cleaning the room, I did the washing too.

items.zh: 除了一个问题以外，别的问题他＿＿回答对了。
items.en: He got all the questions right except one.
What else are you learning besides Chinese?

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence.

items.en: She goes running every day except when it rains.
answers: 除了下雨天，她每天都跑步。
她除了下雨天，每天都跑步。

items.en: Besides rice, I also bought bread.
answers: 除了米饭，我还买了面包。
我除了米饭，还买了面包。

items.en: Where else have you been besides China?
answers: 除了中国，你还去过哪儿？
你除了中国，还去过哪儿？
除了我，大家都不认识他。

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.zh: 除了妹妹以外，我们还吃过饭了。
items.en: We've all eaten except my little sister.
answers: 除了妹妹以外，我们都吃过饭了。

items.zh: 除了牛奶，我都买了鸡蛋。
items.en: As well as milk, I bought some eggs.
answers: 除了牛奶，我还买了鸡蛋。
除了牛奶，我也买了鸡蛋。

items.zh: 除了周末，他每天还很忙。
items.en: He's busy every day except at the weekend.
answers: 除了周末，他每天都很忙。

items.zh: 除了喝茶以外，我都喜欢喝咖啡。
items.en: Besides tea, I like coffee too.
answers: 除了喝茶以外，我还喜欢喝咖啡。
除了喝茶以外，我也喜欢喝咖啡。

items.zh: 除了妈妈，都我们喜欢吃鱼。
items.en: All of us like fish except Mum.
answers: 除了妈妈，我们都喜欢吃鱼。
